title: feat(spec, lint): user-facing refusal and advisory text is in the request locale; authoring findings carry a localized user sentence, security posture first
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuR6myLrdmzXTYxoSyjXrroZ)_
Fixes #32655

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md (Error Envelopes: the `userMessage` locale ladder, and the save and publish doors' `advisories[]` / 422 `issues[]` finding `userMessage`), skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md (server-composed user text follows the request locale, then the workspace default, then `en`)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：协议里写明，报错和保存提示中给最终用户看的文字（`userMessage`）按请求的语言给出（请求语言，其次工作区默认语言，最后英文）；保存和发布返回的提示条目可以带一句 `userMessage`；7 条安全类保存提示在 11 种平台语言里都有了用户文案。
- 为什么改：执行维护者裁决「32440 选C，32043 一起按C处理」。中文用户保存后看到的是英文安全提醒；现在由出提醒的规则自己按用户语言出文案，规则 id 不变。
- 风险与回滚：只新增一个可选字段和一批文案，现有返回内容一字不变（服务端还没填这个字段，那是第 2 层的卡）；`@objectstack/spec` 因新增字段按 minor 发版；回滚就是撤回本 PR。本 PR 取代 #32721（同一份改动，换到本线程分支续做）。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`（新字段的说明）、`packages/lint/src/finding-user-text.ts`（语言回退规则）、`packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.user-text.ts`（各语言文案）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/finding-user-text.test.ts`，应看到 23 个测试全过，其中有带对象名的中文和英文提示。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

This replaces #32721. It is the same development: that PR's head `9925cc13` was taken over by this card thread on its own branch, which the platform assigns (the original branch is not pushable from here). On top of it come a merge of current `main` (`88282a78`) and the changeset round the seat ruled: `@objectstack/spec` goes `patch` → `minor`, and `Metadata-protocol: none` becomes `added`.

Layer 1 of #32654 (the contract), under ruling record 6819749037 on #32440: option C of analysis 6819513436, 「服务端按请求语言返回本地化的 advisory 文案，规则 id 不变;控制台、CLI、MCP 都直接得到译文。」

**`packages/spec`.** These are descriptions and one new optional key.

- `ApiErrorSchema.userMessage` (`src/api/contract.zod.ts`) gains a "Language" section, and `EnhancedApiErrorSchema.userMessage` (`src/api/errors.zod.ts`) points to it. The text is in the request's locale, with this fallback order: the locale the request names (`Accept-Language`, or `?locale` on REST); else the workspace default (the `localization` settings); else `en`. Each one is read against the platform locale table (`PLATFORM_LOCALES` / `platformLocaleTagOf`). A locale that is not on the table, or that the producer has no text for, is passed over for the next one. The producer composes the text, and consumers render it as received. The ruled meaning ("Producer-marked user-facing refusal text, verbatim") does not change; only the language is new.
- `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema` (`src/api/protocol.zod.ts`) is the one finding shape behind the save and publish doors' `advisories[]` and the 422's `issues[]`. It gains an optional `userMessage`, with the same name, the same producer-marked meaning and the same locale rule. `rule` is still the stable id, and `message` / `hint` are still the developer-facing English. A response without the key parses exactly as before. A client that parses a response with the key now keeps it instead of stripping it.
- Regenerated: `content/docs/references/api/*.mdx` (13 pages carry the error envelope) and `authorable-surface/api.json`, which now lists `api/RuntimeAuthoringIssue:userMessage`. `authorable-surface.base.json` is unchanged.

**`packages/lint`: the producer side.** The catalog lives with the producer. That placement is this lane's call within the ruling.

- `AuthoringFinding.userTextParams?` holds the names a finding's user sentence interpolates. A rule cannot see the request, so it emits names, not text.
- `finding-user-text.ts` holds the types, the locale ladder (`userTextLocaleOf` / `renderUserText`), `mergeUserTextCatalogs` (which refuses a rule id that two catalogs both claim) and `FINDING_USER_TEXT_CATALOG`. `findingUserMessage(finding, [requestLocale, workspaceDefault])` returns the `userMessage` value, or `undefined` when the producer authors no sentence for that finding. It is exported from the root entry and from `@objectstack/lint/runtime`, the entry `metadata-protocol` is pinned to.
- `validate-security-posture.user-text.ts` sits beside the rule. It holds one sentence per advisory rule id in all 11 platform locales, using the console's own terms. The seven rules are `security-private-no-readscope`, `security-master-detail-ungranted`, `security-book-audience-unknown-set`, `security-superuser-field-mask-inert`, `security-controlled-by-parent-master-reference-hidden`, `security-update-policy-no-check` and `security-controlled-by-parent-owner-policy-without-opt-in`. Their eight push sites in `validate-security-posture.ts` now set `userTextParams`. Rule ids, messages and hints are unchanged.

**Changeset.** `@objectstack/spec` `minor` and `@objectstack/lint` `patch`, with `Clause-②: yes` and `Metadata-protocol: added`. The new key moves the `api` authorable-surface shard, and AGENTS.md treats a new key as `added`. This is the seat's call A on the declaration question the previous round raised.

**Not in this PR.** The save door composing `userMessage` (layer 2, #32656) and the console rendering it (layer 3, #32657). `metadata-protocol`'s `toIssue` still copies the six keys, so every save and publish response stays byte-identical until #32656 lands.

## Why

The console renders a server advisory such as `security-private-no-readscope` in English inside a zh-CN Studio. The ruling puts the translation where the rule's wording lives. The console, the CLI and MCP then all receive localized text, and no consumer has to keep its own per-rule translation table.

## Tests

All counts are from head `495a9ee9`. That head is `9925cc13` (PR #32721's development) with `main` `88282a78` merged in through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` (merge `d347a64d`, no conflicts, 35 incoming commits), plus the changeset round. A full `pnpm build` ran first (119/119 tasks), and `packages/runtime/.objectstack` was removed.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: Test Files 200 passed (200), Tests 8566 passed (8566). The lock reported `VERDICT command-exit 0`. At `9925cc13` the count was 8559/8559; the 7 new tests come from `main`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 836 passed (836), Tests 26734 passed, 1 todo. `VERDICT command-exit 0`. At `9925cc13` it was 26732.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `packages/lint/src/finding-user-text.test.ts` (23 tests, from the development round):
  - the locale ladder: alias reads (`zh-CN` resolves to `zh-Hans`); the workspace default when the request locale is unset, off the table (`pt-PT`) or has no sentence (`ja`); and `en` as the floor for an unknown locale (`tlh`);
  - the duplicate-catalog refusal, and no sentence for a finding without params;
  - the catalog holds exactly the 7 ids, each in exactly the 11 platform locales;
  - every push site rendered from the rule's real findings in every locale, with the names interpolated, no `undefined`, and no English stand-in;
  - the remedy and bypass variants;
  - a `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` permission write whose advisory renders a `userMessage` that `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema` accepts beside the unchanged rule id.
- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.test.ts`: the finding parses with and without `userMessage`; a non-string value is refused; the save response keeps a localized `userMessage` on an advisory.

<details><summary>Ablation and reverse type check (development round, at b22507da; the tested behaviour did not change in this round)</summary>

Ablation: `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deleted the `userTextParams` line at the `security-private-no-readscope` push site. The anchor count went from 1 to 0 and the blob from `ffd0f96f4b26` to `8c3f3ec817cb`. Result: Tests 3 failed, 20 passed (23), and the three failures are exactly the cases that read that finding. After restore the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The test imports the rule from `src`, so no build sits between the mutation and the run. That file is byte-identical at this head (blob `ffd0f96f4b26`).

Reverse type check: a temporary probe in `packages/lint/src`, compiled against the rebuilt `@objectstack/spec` `.d.ts`, gave exactly one error, `TS2322` on `userMessage: 42`. The string forms compiled, including an excess-property object literal. The probe was deleted.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

1. **Replaces #32721.** That PR's branch `claude/issue-32655-localized-user-text-contract` (head `9925cc13`) is not pushable from this card thread's container, so the work continues on the branch the platform assigns, `claude/project-thread-tpz7ec`, started from that sha with `main` merged in (no rebase, no force-push). The Duplicate Fix Guard sees a branch that does not name the issue. The seat closes #32721 with a pointer here.
2. **Declaration resolved.** The previous round's `Metadata-protocol: none` was refused by `Check Changeset` because the `api` shard moved. The seat ruled A: `added`, with `@objectstack/spec` at `minor`. With this body, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs --event` exits 0 (see Verification).
3. **`Skills-docs:` follow-up owed.** The two skills files named above should teach the new field. Product PRs never edit `skills/**`, so the seat files the card and rewrites the line to its number before ACCEPT.
4. **Remaining advisory rules.** A static scan at `9925cc13` found 74 lint rule ids that the save door can return as advisories; this PR covers 7 of them. The other **67, in 36 rule files**, are drafted as a tracking card plus five per-domain sub-cards for the seat to file. None of those 36 files changed on `main` since the scan. Until they land, those advisories render the declared English fallback. `metadata-protocol`'s own gate-local advisories belong to layer 2.
5. **The 70 non-English sentences are agent-written.** No native speaker has read them. A review card is drafted for the seat (ar, ja, ko and zh-Hant first), and layer 3 (#32657) should wait on it before rendering them to users.
6. **CLI JSON grows one key.** `os validate --json` / `os build --json` serialize findings as they are, so the seven security advisories now also show `userTextParams` in `warnings`. The change is additive, and no CLI test pins that element's exact shape.
7. **For layer 2 (#32656).** In `toIssue` (`metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.ts`), add `userMessage: findingUserMessage(f, [requestLocale, workspaceDefaultLocale])` when it is defined, imported from `@objectstack/lint/runtime`. Pass both locales: `ExecutionContext.locale` folds them into one value, which drops the workspace default when the request names a locale that is not on the table.
8. **A standing-rule conflict, flagged.** This body's last line is the relay's HTML-comment `signed:` trailer, as the dispatch asked, while `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` forbids HTML comments in dev-written GitHub text. A `domain:skills` finding card is drafted for the seat.

## Verification

All on head `495a9ee9`.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 113 commands, the same list as at `9925cc13`. 112 exited 0 on the first pass. `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exited 3 (a prerequisite): the shallow clone lacked its pinned fixture commit. After `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876` it exits 0 with 48 cases.
  - `--ran` reconciliation, with each line recorded as `COMMAND :: exit CODE`: "113 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 113 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 113 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date". Its first run reported `check:test-typecheck` stale with "tsc failed without diagnostics", which was the default heap running out, not drift. With `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`, that gate reads 52 files / 240 errors / 131 pinned signatures, held, and the wrapper is all green. The tree is clean after the run.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main --event EVENT.json`, with this body as the payload: exit 0, "LEVEL AXIS: this PR declares clause-② `yes` and metadata-protocol `added`, and it grades a package whose published source … it moves at `minor` or above — the declared widening is accounted for: @objectstack/spec: minor". `@objectstack/lint` is graded `patch` and not refused.
- `npx eslint --no-inline-config` on the 11 changed TypeScript files: exit 0. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` run is CI's.
- No dogfood battery: the title has no `!` and `Clause-②:` carries no `(narrowing)` arm. The full CI farm, `test:repo` included, is CI's.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
